description: How to build a QueueSim Cloud model: the node types (arrivals, service, delay, split, settype, bytype, exit), staff groups, distributions, plan limits and a worked example. Call this before check_queue_model or run_queue_model when the user's system has more than one step (several stations in a row, shared staff, routing by percent or customer type, priority customers, people who give up or are turned away). Text only, no simulation.
name: queue_model_guide
